reason: Operationalize the preregistered deterministic systematic temporal thinning policy for final TRAIN+DEV fit-freeze.

fit_row_policy.complete_case_universe: For each frozen coordinate, define one complete-case row universe using target plus the full challenger feature-column set. Baseline and challenger use exactly these same rows.
fit_row_policy.split_application: Apply thinning independently to TRAIN and DEV, matching the preregistered max_rows_per_split_regime=250000 policy.
fit_row_policy.thinning: After stable sort within each split, if rows exceed 250000, keep every ceil(n/250000)-th row from the first row and truncate to 250000; otherwise keep all rows.
fit_row_policy.final_fit_order: Concatenate thinned TRAIN rows followed by thinned DEV rows. Fit separate baseline/challenger scalers and same-class estimators on that identical combined row universe.
fit_row_policy.block_length_input: Bootstrap block-length selection remains separate and uses all TRAIN rows with finite target, aggregated to one-minute event means as specified by 005F-AMENDMENT-009; it is not based on the thinned model-fit sample.
